namedThirteenClassesVerbatim: FC-JOIN-HOST-OUTSIDE-DR105 — consentable host-side attempts outside DR-105 are exactly CA-1 SPAWN decision, CA-1 IN_PROCESS, CA-2 process-creation decision, CA-3, and CA-4-HOST

FC-JOIN-HOST-DEFAULT-AND-OPMETA — host default reads and doctor's operational-metadata write are not DR-105 component grants and are not on the consentable CA-1..CA-4 roster; fail-closed if the applicable host class is denied; BLK-6 stays DISCHARGED-AS-INAPPLICABLE; no token is minted
FC-JOIN-DOCTOR-CONSENT-NOT-GRANT — a doctor consent record is invocation-bound and is not journaled as a grant

FC-JOIN-COMPONENT-TAIL — after a host CA-1 SPAWN decision, every subsequent effect of the admitted child stays in DR-105; egress is typed PT-NET-EGRESS and is not doctor/host CA-4; representative non-egress admitted-child DR-105 routes include PT-FS-READ-PROJECT, PT-FS-READ-COMPONENT, PT-FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE, PT-PROC-EXEC-DECLARED, PT-ENV-READ, and PT-HOST-EFFECT-BROKERED (non-exhaustive under the EVERY-effect rule); PT-FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE is the component token, distinct from doctor's unprefixed FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE operational-metadata write (BLK-6); the SPAWN decision is excluded from that tail
FC-JOIN-CA2-TAIL — a CA-2 process-creation decision is host-side; the customer tool's later effects are neither admitted-component PT-NET-EGRESS nor host CA-4

FC-JOIN-FAIL-CLOSED-UNRECORDED — absence of joint-owner FC-C1 recording denies the five-member consentable host-side roster: CA-1 SPAWN, CA-1 IN_PROCESS, CA-2, CA-3, and CA-4-HOST; for CA-1 IN_PROCESS this is not the surviving denial
FC-JOIN-CA2-UNEXERCISABLE — CA-2 remains wholly unexercisable; DR-119 is necessary and not sufficient

FC-JOIN-CA2-D000-GATE — even if FC-C1 and DR-119 are present, CA-2 remains denied while the later D-000 product/authorization decision is absent; that decision is named from recorded host-effect v8/v25, not extracted from D-032, and is not minted here

FC-JOIN-CA1-INPROCESS-UNEXERCISABLE — CA-1 IN_PROCESS remains denied in the architecture preview even when FC-C1 is recorded and the host-effect contract is otherwise sufficient; it cannot be relabeled as SPAWN; attributed to recorded host-effect v8/v25, not D-032

FC-JOIN-INHERITED-PERM-RECITAL — permission v2/v6 CA-1/CA-2 PT-NET-EGRESS recital is resolved in recorded permission-truth-tables.v9 / D-128; this leftover-integration names that environment and does not apply v9
FC-JOIN-BLK-STILL-ROUTED — BLK-1..BLK-4 remain STILL-ROUTED after this candidate exists
notAFourteenthClass: Doctor FC implementations (FC-RO, FC-NC, FC-NN, and the other G12 classes) remain OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING on DR-114. They are not join-fixture classes and are not a fourteenth class here.
